query:
SELECT m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, s.companyName
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId IN ('8952301', '9477501')
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
